Burlok's Experiments
[[img:bullet_dwf_crafting]][[/img]] Seek out exotic ingredients during your campaign to perform experiments in return for unique rewards.
The Reveller of Slaanesh

[[img:ui/campaign ui/skills/hkrul_dolmance_special_0_2.png]][[/img]] Dolmance does not have access to worship buildings and Prophetesses, but has access to Slaanesh units and Chaos Sorcerers of Slaanesh instead.\\n\\n[[img:icon_devotees]][[/img]] Gather Devotees throughout your campaign to spend on Pleasurable Acts that benefit your home regions, or build a special building that allows you to recruit Slaanesh's followers.\\n\\n[[img:ui/campaign ui/effect_bundles/resource_wine.png]][[/img]] Collect wine-producing places across the world, which give extraordinary benefits to Dolmance.
Mercenary Reputation
[[img:ui/campaign ui/skills/hkrul_hroth_special_0_1.png]][[/img]] Win battles to increase your reputation and make mercenary contracts across the world.
Embrace of the Cold
[[img:ui/campaign ui/skills/innate_sceolan.png]][[/img]] Your forces will gain a special ability if they start a turn in a Magical Forest or Frozen climate settlement.
Fallen Brethren

[[img:ui/campaign ui/skills/hkrul_slaurith_special_0_1.png]][[/img]] Seek out your past fellow knights by occupying the settlements and defeating the characters that protect them to gain great powers.
Path to Daemonhood

[[img:hkrul_image_khazag]][[/img]] Thorgar's sole ambition is to ascend as a Daemon Prince, which he can achieve through various Paths to Glory.\\n\\n[[img:icon_confederation]][[/img]] Defeat the faction leaders of rival Norscan tribes to be given the option to form tribal confederations.
Tycoon of the Transit Trade
[[img:icon_caravan_cargo]][[/img]] Send trade caravans across the world and become the tycoon of the transit trade.
Slaves for the Blood God

[[img:icon_chaos_gifts]][[/img]] Capture Slaves and sacrifice them to the Dark Gods in return for factionwide boons granted by Khorne.\\n\\n[[img:icon_army]][[/img]] Send your forces into multiple successive battles to progress through Bloodletting levels and accumulate bonuses.
Grimoires for the Changer
[[img:icon_chaos_gifts]][[/img]] Grimoires can also be sacrificed to the Dark Gods in return for factionwide boons granted by Tzeentch.
The Shadeheart Fortress
[[img:icon_books_of_nagash]][[/img]] Amplify the powers of the Books of Nagash by constructing the Shadeheart Fortress at Zacharias' homeland, the Forest of Shadows, Wolfenburg.
Herald of Archaon
[[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]] Empower Archaon and yourself by collecting souls and handing off settlements to him.
The Ice Wolves
[[img:ui/campaign ui/skills/hkrul_aelfric_special_0_1.png]][[/img]] After winning a battle against human factions, Ice Wolves may join your army if there is an empty unit slot available.
The Master Hunter

[[img:hkrul_image_tokmars]][[/img]] Surtha Lenk is a master hunter with the ability to trap and tame even the fiercest of beasts through the monster pen mechanic.\\n\\n[[img:icon_confederation]][[/img]] Defeat the faction leaders of rival Norscan tribes to be given the option to form tribal confederations.
The Realm of Amenemhetum
[[img:ui/campaign ui/skills/hkrul_kita_special_0_1.png]][[/img]] Grow your strength and reconquer Amenemhetum the Great's realm to show your might unto the world.
Duriath's Flagship
[[img:bullet_def_black_arks]][[/img]] Duriath has access to his special flagship. While it gives him great benefits, he can only recruit units on land when garrisoned inside a settlement.
Vigil of the North

[[img:icon_dread]][[/img]] Hold the Watch Towers of Naggaroth and defeat the forces of Chaos to raise the Vigil of the North. Towers in the hands of outsiders and lost battles will weaken it, and should it fall too low, Chaos warbands will break through the northern border.\\n\\n[[img:icon_slaves]][[/img]] Each Watch Tower empowers your armies against Chaos while you hold at least 500 Slaves, but devours Slaves every turn. As the Keeper of the Iron Key, Dorian has access to enhanced Slave Diktats and can spend Vigil to kindle the beacons of a province.
